parsedVerdict.reasoning:
The unit has one file, src/domain/models.ts. It holds only the task-management domain's data types: TaskStatus, User, Task, Project and Repository. They all reference each other: Task.status uses TaskStatus, Project.tasks is Task[], and Repository holds Map<string, Project> and Map<string, User>. Nothing in the file belongs to an unrelated concern. The file has no behaviour, so no rule is duplicated within it and none of the module's abstractions are bypassed.

Two minor concerns don't amount to a failure:
- Repository exposes concrete Map storage rather than an abstract port, which leaks how data is stored into the domain types.
- The task–project link is stored twice, as Task.projectId and as Project.tasks. Both copies have to be kept in sync, which is a possible duplicated invariant.

These are design issues, not a split into unrelated concerns, so the file passes.
